objective: Determine whether the current @ran-sh/dsh-crew v0.3.0 release candidate is safe and ready for publication, without creating a tag, GitHub Release, or npm publication.
context: GitHub issue #41 tracks this final non-publishing release gate. PR #40 prepared v0.3.0 and was merged to main after final isolated real-environment acceptance. This task is the last publication-readiness check only. Validate the exact source revision actually executed and package payload; do not repeat destructive installation/recovery work and do not read or mutate the user's official DSH credential/config stores.
forbidden_changes: git tags or refs, including creating or moving v0.3.0
GitHub Releases or release publication state
npm publish, npm dist-tags, or any registry mutation
package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, CHANGELOG.md, or release/version metadata
src/**, test/**, scripts/**, agents/**, commands/**, codex/**, statusline/**, .github/**, or other product/workflow files
installation, uninstall, or mutation of dsh-crew runtime state
the user's normal ~/.dsh, official DSH web profile, credential stores, provider key files, or other secrets
validation: Validate this Task Contract first: node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs task docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json
Record the exact resolved main HEAD, branch, and pre-execution git status after git pull --ff-only; refuse to discard or overwrite unrelated dirty worktree changes.
Run the full deterministic sweep: node --test test/*.test.mjs
Run the client build: pnpm run build:client
Verify package.json version, src/runtime-identity.mjs runtime identity, and the v0.3.0 CHANGELOG entry are mutually consistent at 0.3.0, without editing them.
Run npm pack --dry-run --json and audit the resulting package file list, package name/version, size metadata, and unexpected payload entries. The dry run must not publish anything.

Audit the npm payload for unintended ACTIVE task files, agent result files, temporary/build scratch files, local environment files, credentials/secrets, test-only artifacts, or other development-only material not intended by package.json files/exports.
Run git diff --check and record git status after validation; package/test/build checks must not leave tracked product changes.
Confirm remote git tag refs/tags/v0.3.0 does not already exist. Treat network/auth inability to verify as BLOCKED, not as proof of absence.
Confirm no GitHub Release for v0.3.0 already exists. Treat network/auth/tooling inability to verify as BLOCKED, not as proof of absence.

Confirm npm registry does not already contain @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.0. Distinguish an authoritative package/version-not-found response from network/auth/registry failures; unverifiable state is BLOCKED.

Write schema_version 2 Result Contract to docs/agent-results/TASK-V030-RELEASE-GATE-result.json with evidence for every gate item and an explicit overall release_gate conclusion of RELEASE_READY or BLOCKED.

Stamp and revalidate the result: node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs result docs/agent-results/TASK-V030-RELEASE-GATE-result.json --stamp, then validate the stamped result again before commit.
acceptance_criteria: The exact executed source revision and clean-worktree provenance are recorded.
Full deterministic tests PASS and client build PASS; skipped, partial, blocked, or unexecuted checks are not converted to PASS.
package.json, src/runtime-identity.mjs, and CHANGELOG.md consistently identify v0.3.0.
npm pack --dry-run succeeds and the audited package payload contains no unintended task/result/temp/secret/development artifacts.
v0.3.0 is authoritatively confirmed absent as a remote git tag and as a GitHub Release.
@ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.0 is authoritatively confirmed absent from the configured npm registry.
No tag, GitHub Release, npm publication, registry mutation, version edit, product edit, installer mutation, credential access, or official DSH store mutation occurs.
The Result Contract is validator-stamped PASS and states RELEASE_READY only if every required release gate is PASS; otherwise it states BLOCKED with the exact blocker(s).
On real completion, ACTIVE_TASK.json is deleted according to the workflow and only the authorized Result Contract plus task deletion are committed/pushed.
